Author: Party Bus
Name: Party Bus
Punchline: Your crew's venue list: ratings, addresses, open alerts.
Description: Keep a list of the venues you and your friends visit, filled in automatically from where you're standing. Mark each one green (liked) or red (didn't). The list syncs with your crew through party chat. The Open Now tab shows every venue advertising in Party Finder, and Party Bus pings your party when a liked venue opens. Open with /partybus or /pbus.
